title: <name> and the Case of the Sneaky Socks

pages.text:
One sunny afternoon, <name> noticed something strange — his socks kept disappearing from the laundry basket!

“Where are they going?” he wondered, scratching his head.

He spotted a rolled-up sock peeking from behind the chair. Tiptoeing carefully, he crawled closer, only to see tiny paw prints leading across the living room.

“Ah! A sock thief!” he whispered. He followed the trail, giggling as a playful kitten darted past, batting a sock like a little soccer ball. <name> tiptoed and rolled under the sofa, keeping the kitten in sight.

Next, he noticed giggling shadows dancing along the wall. The shadows seemed to be moving toward the hallway. Carefully, <name> peeked around the corner — and saw a funny sight: the socks were stacked in a tiny fort built by the kitten, complete with a rolled-up blanket and a little toy mouse.

“Found you, socks!” <name> laughed, scooping them up. The kitten purred happily, and the socks wiggled in his hands as if joining the fun.

<name> learned that paying attention to small clues and following them patiently could solve even the silliest of mysteries — and sometimes, the solution is as funny as the problem itself.
